risks.risk: Wrong vehicle fitment (Rogue vs Altima; also could be different transmission code/gear ratios). Photos don’t show the transmission code/part number.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the transmission ID plate/label and/or stamped transmission code, plus the VIN/engine/transmission code compatibility list.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used gearbox with uncertain fitment (worst-case: may not bolt up / wrong spec).

risks.risk: Transmission type mismatch (automatic vs CVT vs manual) and internal damage not visible externally.
risks.proof: A short video of the unit running/test (or at least proof of bench test) and photos showing the transmission type identifiers (e.g., valve body/CVT markings) and fluid condition.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst-case: treat as faulty/unknown condition).

risks.risk: “Never opened” may be false; seals/gaskets could have been replaced or the unit could have been opened before.
risks.proof: Photos of all cover seams/gasket lines and any tamper marks/bolt head condition; close-ups of the bellhousing/side cover areas.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possibly opened/unknown history (worst-case: no trust premium).

risks.risk: “No knock/low mileage” cannot be confirmed; internal wear could exist.
risks.proof: Bench test report or video showing smooth engagement and no abnormal noise, plus mileage/odometer proof from the donor vehicle.
risks.if_unproven: Price as high-wear used unit (worst-case: expect overhaul risk).

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the transmission ID plate/label and any stamped codes (photo 0/1 currently don’t show readable identifiers).
Video proof of testing/operation (engagement + no abnormal noise) or a mechanic’s test report.
Photos of fluid condition (if applicable) and any service/inspection documents from the donor vehicle.
Compatibility proof: which Nissan model/engine/transmission code it fits (Rogue/Altima) and whether it’s automatic/CVT/manual.
response.reason: From the photos, the gearbox type and exact Nissan transmission code are not readable, so the key details needed to price it correctly (fitment + working status) are missing. The seller’s claims can’t be verified remotely without the ID/test proof.
